description: This file defines the ApplyJobVacancyViewController class, which manages the presentation logic for applying to a job vacancy. It retrieves vacancy data, verifies its status, and prepares a Vue.js component for the application interface, including properties like vacancy ID, banner URL, allowed file types, CSRF token, and max file size. It also handles bad request scenarios.

classes.name: ApplyJobVacancyViewController
classes.description: A controller class for rendering the job vacancy application view, integrating Vue.js component setup and request validation.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and components for rendering the vacancy application page, fetching vacancy info, validating its status, and configuring the Vue component with relevant properties.

methods.name: handleBadRequest
methods.description: Handles invalid requests by returning a response with HTTP 400 status code.
